items.difficulty_reason: The argument combines the Leray spectral sequence from sites-cohomology with the parasitic-kernel/cokernel mechanism: the adjunction map between the two derived pushforwards has parasitic kernel and cokernel, whose cohomology vanishes, so the E_2 pages agree and the spectral sequences identify.
